import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc['word/document.xml']
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName('w:p')

def para_text(p):
    return ''.join(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else '' for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'))

changed = 0
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    text = para_text(p)
    letters = [c for c in text if c.isalpha()]
    if letters and text == text.upper():
        runs = [c for c in p.childNodes if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE and c.tagName == 'w:r']
        for r in runs:
            rPrs = [c for c in r.childNodes if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE and c.tagName == 'w:rPr']
            if rPrs:
                rPr = rPrs[0]
            else:
                rPr = editor.dom.createElement('w:rPr')
                r.insertBefore(rPr, r.firstChild) if r.firstChild else r.appendChild(rPr)
            us = [c for c in rPr.childNodes if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE and c.tagName == 'w:u']
            if not us:
                u = editor.dom.createElement('w:u')
                u.setAttribute('w:val', 'single')
                rPr.appendChild(u)
        changed += 1
        print(f'[{i}] underlined: "{text}"')

print(f'Total headlines underlined: {changed}')
doc.save()
